// diagnostic

E1234

`{name}` {version} already exists in the registry index and is not yanked.

What

`{name}` {version} already exists in the registry index and is not yanked.

Why

Published versions are immutable (D-VERSION1) — a version can never be overwritten, only yanked, so anyone who already locked it keeps building the exact same bytes.

Fix

Bump the version in `package.jet` and publish again, or `jet registry yank {version}` the existing one first if it was a mistake (yanking hides it from new resolution; it does not free the version number for reuse).
